```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" />
<style>
  .info-tooltip { font-size: 13px; }
  .map-wrap { border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); }
</style>
```

Hover over a region to see its NHS 111 mental health call-line figures. Use the controls below to change month and metric.

```{ojs}
tidy = FileAttachment("data/processed/nhs111_tidy.json").json()
regions = FileAttachment("data/processed/nhs_regions.geojson").json()
```

```{ojs}
L = require("leaflet@1.9.4")
d3 = require("d3@7")
```

```{ojs}
months = [...new Set(tidy.map(d => d.month))].sort()
monthLabels = new Map(tidy.map(d => [d.month, d.month_label]))
metrics = [...new Set(tidy.map(d => d.metric))]
metricLabels = new Map(tidy.map(d => [d.metric, d.metric_label]))
metricUnits = new Map(tidy.map(d => [d.metric, d.unit]))
```

```{ojs}
viewof selectedMonth = Inputs.select(
  months,
  {
    label: "Month",
    format: m => monthLabels.get(m),
    value: months[0]
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
viewof selectedMetric = Inputs.select(
  metrics,
  {
    label: "Metric",
    format: m => metricLabels.get(m),
    value: "calls_received"
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
filtered = tidy.filter(d => d.month === selectedMonth && d.metric === selectedMetric)
valueByRegion = new Map(filtered.map(d => [d.region, d.value]))
```

```{ojs}
colorScale = d3.scaleSequential(d3.interpolateBlues)
  .domain(d3.extent(filtered, d => d.value))
```

```{ojs}
// Small helper to format a value for display, based on its unit
formatValue = (v, unit) => {
  if (v == null) return "no data";
  if (unit === "%") return `${v.toFixed(1)}%`;
  if (unit === "per 100k") return `${v.toFixed(1)} per 100k`;
  if (unit === "seconds") return `${v.toFixed(0)} sec`;
  return v.toLocaleString();
}
```

```{ojs}
map = {
  const container = html`<div class="map-wrap" style="height:600px;"></div>`;
  yield container;

  const leafletMap = L.map(container).setView([52.9, -1.5], 6);

  L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
    attribution: "&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors",
    maxZoom: 10
  }).addTo(leafletMap);

  const unit = metricUnits.get(selectedMetric);
  const label = metricLabels.get(selectedMetric);

  function style(feature) {
    const v = valueByRegion.get(feature.properties.region);
    return {
      fillColor: v == null ? "#cccccc" : colorScale(v),
      weight: 1.5,
      color: "#555555",
      fillOpacity: 0.85
    };
  }

  function onEachFeature(feature, layer) {
    const v = valueByRegion.get(feature.properties.region);
    layer.bindTooltip(
      `<strong>${feature.properties.region}</strong><br>${label}: ${formatValue(v, unit)}`,
      { sticky: true, className: "info-tooltip" }
    );
    layer.on({
      mouseover: e => e.target.setStyle({ weight: 3, color: "#222" }),
      mouseout: e => e.target.setStyle({ weight: 1.5, color: "#555555" })
    });
  }

  const geoLayer = L.geoJson(regions, { style, onEachFeature }).addTo(leafletMap);
  leafletMap.fitBounds(geoLayer.getBounds(), { padding: [10, 10] });

  return container;
}
```

```{ojs}
legend = {
  const [min, max] = colorScale.domain();
  const unit = metricUnits.get(selectedMetric);
  return html`<div style="margin-top:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:13px;">
    <span>${formatValue(min, unit)}</span>
    <div style="width:220px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;
      background:linear-gradient(to right, ${colorScale(min)}, ${colorScale((min + max) / 2)}, ${colorScale(max)});">
    </div>
    <span>${formatValue(max, unit)}</span>
  </div>`
}
```
